faqs.a:
All licenses granted pursuant to this chapter shall be for a term of one year. Said
               term shall commence on January 1 of each year and terminate on December 31 of the
               same year. Applications for a license filed at any other time during the year shall
               be treated the same as if they were filed January 1 of that year and shall terminate
               on December 31 of that same year, and no proration shall be permitted.
(Code 1981, § 4-16; Ord. No. 3217, § 2, 9-18-1995; Ord. No. 3810, § 1, 6-16-2003)
